Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question’s landmarks, treating “Brook Bar” as a modern pub (and even using “tool” instead of “toll”) rather than recognizing the historical “Brooks Bar” toll gate in Manchester. This led to directing searches toward “The Brook” pub in Sale, a wrong location, and set the entire process on an irrelevant path instead of focusing on the area between the historic toll gates “Brooks Bar” and “Trafford Bar,” where Old Trafford (Manchester United) is located.
